scenarios.name: Consensus (West Bengal Landfall)
scenarios.description: Model-weighted consensus track. Most probable path.

analogs.historical_outcome: Cat-5 equivalent at peak; rapid weakening post-landfall; effective evacuation saved lives.
Extremely severe; landfall near Puri; significant coastal surge.
Rapid intensification followed by eyewall replacement; landfall Vizag.
